text: Latest stable Angular 22.x is resolved at execution, exact versions locked, supported peer dependencies verified; Angular 21/23/next/rc are rejected.
The app is standalone, zoneless, client-rendered only; no SSR/prerender/hydration/server artifacts or Angular PWA worker.
All authored interactive state uses signals; components use input()/output(), computed() for derived state and @if/@for/@switch with stable track keys. Signal Forms manages checkout.
mi-bolt-design 1.0.1 is loaded for EVERY task execution and EVERY independent verification; R01–R26 applicability and evidence are attached; missing skill is a blocker.

Exactly four commerce screen families exist: Home, Catalogue, Product, Purchase. Three shells: Marketing, Shop, Checkout. Purchase includes cart/contact/delivery/review/success and their error states.
Every screen and relevant state respects the provided semantic tokens, Hungarian copy, dark shell, orange primary actions, grid, typography and readable price hierarchy.
All four families and wizard steps work at 320/390/768/1024/1440/1920 CSS px without page overflow; controls remain >=44px, including sticky mobile controls.
Catalogue search, all declared facets, matching-variant price, counts, all sort modes, pagination, direct URLs and browser history agree under latest-request-wins behavior.
Product choice keeps media/color/storage/stock/price synchronized; unavailable combinations never silently substitute another variant; gallery works without 3D.
A single global authoritative mock cart supports add/merge/change/remove, stock/quantity limits, expiry and scoped reload persistence with exact whole-HUF arithmetic.
Contact/delivery/payment selection/review create a real in-memory mock transaction and durable demo receipt; no placeholder success screen unrelated to API state.
COD and mock-card success, decline, pending, timeout, server error, stale quote, stock/price change and unknown outcome have tested recovery paths.
Duplicate clicks, repeated requests and timeout-after-commit produce one order and one stock decrement through atomic idempotent processing.
No payment card data, real fulfillment, external order submission or email is collected/performed; demo labels truthfully describe simulation throughout.
OpenAPI 3.1.0 defines all 16 operations and all wire models/errors/headers; validators enforce schemas and documented domain invariants.
ng-openapi-gen generates the only frontend SDK; no manually duplicated DTOs or direct business fetches in components; regeneration is deterministic and clean.
One reusable MSW handler/domain implementation runs in browser and Node. Mock boot is awaited before Angular. Unknown API traffic fails closed; no real-backend fallback.
Every test uses deterministic mock state and fake clocks/IDs where needed; each context/test is isolated; after dependency provisioning the test environment cannot reach business internet hosts.

UNIT: 100% per-file and overall executable statements, branches, functions and lines for all owned runtime sources. Unvisited files count as zero. Generated/vendor/test-only artifacts are explicitly classified, not covertly excluded.

E2E: independent Chromium browser coverage reaches 100% statements, branches, functions and lines for every owned browser-runtime source, including MSW domain handlers. Unit coverage is never merged into it. Non-browser tooling has separate black-box integration coverage.

All declared requirements, component states and mandatory scenario rows have passing assertions in applicable Chromium/Firefox/WebKit suites; code execution alone is not sufficient functional coverage.
No .skip/.todo/.only, coverage-ignore pragmas, lowered threshold, hidden unreachable-code exclusion or silent retry masks incomplete work; release repeat runs pass without automatic retries.

Accessibility includes semantics, route focus, keyboard-only purchase, screen-reader names/errors, dialogs, reduced motion and 200% text sizing. Automated scans alone are not represented as WCAG certification.

Snapshot allowlist excludes contact/address/draft/raw request data. Reload preserves cart and privacy-minimized receipt; incomplete checkout reload resets personal fields with explanation. Error within the same app session preserves fields.
No analytics, tag manager, tracking pixels, session replay, social integration, chat widget, external fonts, consent SaaS or unnecessary operator framework is shipped.

Optimized static build meets declared budgets under a recorded profile, routes resolve under root/subpath, worker/index cache policy prevents stale boot, and API URLs never receive index.html as a fake JSON response.
3D is excluded by default. If approved, local licensed assets + lazy model-viewer + fallback + same quality requirements are mandatory and O01 blocks final acceptance.

Clean-checkout generation, lint, unit coverage, E2E source/scenario coverage, contract tests, browser matrix, design audit and optimized build all pass with fresh artifacts. All task statuses and remaining limitations are truthful.
